summary: BBB Foods Inc. filed a 424B5 preliminary prospectus supplement for a mixed primary and secondary offering of Class A common shares. The company is offering 700,000 new shares; selling shareholders offer 12,604,174 shares upon conversion of Class C shares. No proceeds accrue to the company from the secondary portion. Bolton Partners Ltd., the CEO's affiliate, exercises limited preemptive rights for 10,000 Class B shares, maintaining ~45% voting power. The filing is a routine registered offering under Rule 424(b)(5), not a special situation. The registration statement is subject to completion with no fixed price yet.
